meta.promptText: Which sarees should I buy online in India for a wedding on a budget?

response.text:
Buying a wedding saree online on a budget requires balancing the rich, festive look of traditional wear with lightweight comfort and smart pricing. Depending on whether you are attending as a guest, part of the immediate family, or the bride looking for budget outfits for pre-wedding functions, several specific saree styles deliver a high-end look without a heavy price tag.

---

### Best Saree Types for Weddings on a Budget

| Saree Style | Ideal Occasion | Why it Works on a Budget | Estimated Price Range (INR) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Art / Semi-Silk Banarasi** | Receptions, Main Wedding, Traditional Rituals | Mimics the royal, heavy-brocade look of pure Katan silk at a fraction of the cost. | ₹1,500 – ₹4,000 |
| **Tissue & Organza Silk** | Cocktail, Evening Reception, Sangeet | Highly trending; gives a glossy, shimmery, designer-wear aesthetic while remaining lightweight. | ₹2,000 – ₹5,000 |
| **Georgette with Sequins/Zari** | Sangeet, Cocktail, Haldi | Offers glamorous sparkle (reminiscent of designer collections) and is very easy to drape. | ₹1,000 – ₹3,000 |
| **Chiffon with Delicate Border** | Day Events, Mehendi, Daytime Wedding | Extremely graceful, falls well, and looks sophisticated with minimal styling. | ₹800 – ₹2,500 |

---

### Top Recommendations by Function

* **For Haldi & Mehendi:** Look for **Chiffon, Georgette, or lightweight Cotton-Silk blend sarees** in bright yellows, limes, or multi-colored prints. They are comfortable for outdoor day events and usually range between ₹800 to ₹2,000.
* **For Sangeet & Cocktail:** Opt for **Tissue Silk, Shimmer Georgette, or Net sarees with sequin or gota-patti work**.[utsarees.in](https://utsarees.in/#:~:text=799.00%20Save%20Rs.%201%2C800.00.%20Sale.%20Quick%20view.,Pure%20Mango%20Silk%20Banarasi%20Saree.%20No%20reviews.) These catch the evening lights beautifully and give a high-end look for roughly ₹1,500 to ₹4,000.
* **For the Main Wedding / Reception:** Choose an **Art Banarasi or Imitation Kanjivaram silk saree** featuring rich zari weaving on the pallu and borders. They provide the traditional, grand appearance associated with Indian weddings for around ₹2,000 to ₹5,000.

---

### Best Online Platforms to Shop

* **Curated Ethnic Wear Sites (Great for Quality & Assurance):** Platforms like **Koskii**, **Kalki Fashion**, and **Mohi** feature dedicated wedding sections with reliable fabrics and clear close-up images.[www.koskii.com](https://www.koskii.com/collections/sarees#:~:text=If%20you%20are%20looking%20for%20sarees%20near,Kanjivaram%20sarees%2C%20Banarasi%20silk%20sarees%2C%20and%20more.)
* **Mainstream Fashion Retailers (Great for Sales & Quick Delivery):** **Myntra** and **Ajio** frequently run heavy discounts on trusted ethnic brands like *Sangria*, *Anouk*, and various regional labels.[www.myntra.com](https://www.myntra.com/saree#:~:text=418.%20BAESD.%20Ready%20To%20Wear%20Baluchari%20Saree.,Ready%20to%20wear%20Pocket%20Saree.%20Pixie%20lane.)
* **Direct-to-Consumer / Direct Weaver Sites:** Portals specializing in regional weaves (like *UT Sarees* for Banarasis) often cut out middlemen, giving you better craftsmanship for your budget.

---

### Tips for Buying Wedding Sarees Online

1.  **Check the Blouse Piece Detail:** Ensure the product description explicitly states "with unstitched blouse piece," as some budget listings sell the saree separately, requiring you to source matching fabric independently.
2.  **Read Fabric Specifications:** Real pure silk is expensive; if a listing says "Pure Silk" for ₹800, it is blended or art silk. Look for transparent labels like *Art Silk*, *Kora Tissue*, *Poly Georgette*, or *Chiffon* so you know what to expect.
3.  **Factor in Tailoring Time:** Keep a buffer of 5 to 7 days before the event to get your blouse stitched locally, as readymade blouses online can sometimes miss the right fit.
